verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation SDK with hosted components (server-side caching, Browserbase sessions), so registrable outbound event webhooks are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents webhooks or any registrable HTTP callback for events. Observability dashboards and MCP integrations are adjacent features and do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
